And it makes more sense because it doesn't hide the half-circle.

The function e^(x*i) starts at 1 in x = 0, goes to -1 in x = Pi (half-circle) and then to 1 again in x = 2*Pi = Tau (full circle).

Tau is really just a Tau = 2*Pi substitution, but so many things start to make sense when you do the substitution from the start.

Or, you know, it's just two ways of writing the exact same thing, and there's really no point in changing 2*Pi into Tau.

There is a point. Of course students still need to know about Pi because of tradition, but Tau is better when explaining new concepts to students and pupils. Many educators report improvements in students' understanding when teaching in Tau over Pi.

This just represents a rotation of pi radians (180 degrees) in the complex plane. Likewise, e^(pi/2i) is a ninety degree rotation and equal to i, e^(3pi/2i) is -i, and e^0 is obviously 1.

Well there are many many reasons. I assume you can think of some yourself, but I'll give you a couple to get you started.

  • The number of searches only indicates what some random users are looking for and does not contain the traffic numbers or backstory of why the person was doing the search
  • There is no context in a summation; ie: there are more bees in my town now because more people have been stung is the same as saying "voat is gaining on reddit because an equal number of people searched for reddit.com and voat.co", whereas most of those searches could be from global journalists covering the news that voat is gaining on reddit -- ie: the reason is causing the reason
  • Only dumb people search for web addresses on a search engine: ie: if you type in cnn.com in the google search box, you are an idiot unless you are looking for domain related info in which case you are still an idiot
  • Changing the search terms to reddit and voat without the domains has a different result
  • Google tends to offer searches to people based on that specific person, so another country or city search will likely yield different results
  • Google is closed source so we don't know why they offer certain results
